descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P2 · extra (accessibility, performance, prototype detail) · ours: tap size on phone width / WebKit / Android.

Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S23 Phone width, WebKit and the Android app: the patient card's trash icon can be tapped without hitting the card

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Deleting a patient asks for confirmation exactly once: tapping the card's trash icon opens a pop-up designed like the app UI that says what deleting does, with Cancel and OK; Cancel keeps everything. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-92579 AC 7; TFA-94699 AC 6)
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Visual lane on Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit) for hospital-list and nh-list with the fixture patient and resident; the Android debug APK of main on the rc_api36 emulator against the local stack through adb reverse (scripts/android-lane.ts)

When Render the Hospital and Nursing Home lists on each target

Then The Hospital card's trash icon is at least 24 x 24 CSS px (44 pt on phones), not covered and not overlapping the open-chart target; the Nursing Home list's delete control is recorded (none on main, Q7). Item trash icons (tasks, points, meds) and the confirmation / deleted-message states are not rendered by the lanes today and are not claimed here (S28).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Visual-lane tap / covered / overflow findings on the two list screens (WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8; Apple HIG 44 pt), evidence for a human.

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
